title: Kissed Pan American Veal Casserole
description: A comforting and flavorful casserole featuring lean veal and a rich, tamasic-friendly gravy, served in a traditional Indian kadhai vessel.

ingredients.name: 2 cups mixed frozen vegetables (e.g. peas, carrots, corn)
1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, for serving (optional)

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in the kadhai over medium-high heat.
Add cumin seeds and coriander seeds; cook 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add veal and cook 2-3 minutes, until browned on all sides. Remove veal from kadhai.
Add remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil to kadhai; reduce heat to medium.
Add onion and garlic; cook 3-4 minutes, until onion is translucent.
Add flour; cook 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Slowly add beef broth and tomato paste; whisk until combined.
Add diced tomatoes and mixed vegetables; stir to combine.
Return veal to kadhai; season with salt, pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Add chopped cilantro and kasoori methi (if using); stir to combine.
Transfer kadhai to preheated oven; cover with lid.
Bake 25-30 minutes, until veal is cooked through and gravy is bubbly.
Garnish with chopped scallions and shredded mozzarella cheese (if using).
Serve hot, straight from the kadhai.
Serve as a comforting and flavorful dinner, perfect for any occasion.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped cilantro and lemon wedges (if desired).
